'''Michael Robinson Whippany NJ Fat Moose (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Michael Robinson]] posted on DeckTech on 18 January 2001 about [[January 2001 Whippany tournament]].<ref name="tr-d1641">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-18-whippany-nj-fat-moosed1641/ whippany-nj-fat-moose], DeckTech (Michael "Bobafett465" Robinson, 18 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-18-whippany-nj-fat-moosed1641/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Michael Robinson finished 2nd, behind Tom Hermley-Keen, at a local tournament at Moose's (Fat Moose) in Whippany, New Jersey, in January 2001, going 2–2 over four games with Hunt Down and MWYHL.

== Original report ==

'''whippany-nj-fat-moose'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "Bobafett465" Robinson
* '''Published:''' Jan 18, 2001

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
  		I got up at like 9:30 in order to make the 11:45 tournament at Moose&#8217;s. This was going to be my first tournament there in weeks, because my decks were not ready by the time a tournament came around.(If you are wondering why its because I&#8217;ve been spending a month trying to counteract the huge amount of whoopass going into dark side JP after JPSD came out.) My decks were a 5-0 in tournament play Huntdown, and a brand spanking new MWYHL test to four , which as of now is a test to six.



GAME 1 : HUNTDOWN VS. John Torres&#8217;s HIDDEN BASE



	This was a relatively slow game when it comes to Huntdown, considering that we had one ground battle the entire game. He started the usual, Squassin, Insurrection, and Insight. I started IAO, Mob points, and No Escape. He spent most of his time sending his ships to the Rendezvous Point for like &#8211;5 each, and then moving them out. I got a dbay down, and vader w/ stick with tarkin down. He again went to the air , and put dash and outrider at kessel. I sent bossk in bus on a suicide, and forgot that dash subtracts 6 from power, so I got smacked. He sent EPP leia, and chewie down to the dbay. I smack them around, take no damage. He flipped later, after some problems with the hidden base, but I drain him out and won by 25.



FW 2(+25)

HIGHS: Huntdown is 6-0

LOWS: Bossk getting smacked.





GAME 2 : MWYHL VS. Moose&#8217;s EMPEROR/DSJP SMACK



	Ok, this didn&#8217;t go as well as I would have hoped with a new deck. I started the Wise Advise combo card instead of the regular which was still I my deck. Big mistake. Didn&#8217;t see it didn&#8217;t add to training destiny. So guess what? Second turn , attempt test one, break even at 12. He sets up his JP drain with Emperor , Gailid and Mosep. Luckily, Test 1 stopped that, but still, the drain off top of reserve were killing me. I took to the air, he laterals home one, I&#8217;m screwed. Lost by 12.



FL 2(+11)

HIGHS: NOTIN

LOWS: LOSIN





GAME 3 : MWYHL VS . Vikram Bali&#8217;s BHBM



	This time I start Wise Advise. I get Rebel Scout Luke and Saber to the docking bay, and he ignores me by putting Lord Vader at Endor Dbay. I drain a few turns, get to test 4 , and he sends in the smack. Dengar, Mara, and Lord Vader move over to the Luke site. Damn, just Obi w/ in my hand. Vader caps , and I&#8217;m in trouble. But wait! I send Vader to the throne room automatically cuz of luke&#8217;s text, and deploy obi. Hit mara , he misses. Lose wedge, he covers, but he loses everything. But still got out drained in the start. Loss by 18.



FL 2(-7)

HIGHS: SMACKDOWN

LOWS: COULD&#8217;VE WON.





GAME 4 : HUNTDOWN VS. Vikram Bali&#8217;s PROFIT



	Revenge! Or is it ? I &#8216;d finally get to see what my Huntdown was made of. I start draining quick, he frees Han 4th turn. Damn! So, he sends leia with wax lando, han, and luke over to battle DVDLOTS w/ saber and dengar w/ and fett w/. I intiate, choke han. He attempts to swing at vader&#8230;. No . force field. I hit leia. He misses dengar. I hit luke. He attepts to exclude dengar, I draw 6 he draws 2.his destiny, 0 . Mine, 5 . He loses everything, I lose nothing. Need I say more?? Win by 30.



FW 4(+23)

HIGHS: THE SMACKDOWN OF THE TOURNAMENT!

LOWS: NOTIN



	So, I finished second only to Tom Hernley-Keen. Got 5 CC packs, had a lot of fun. Hope you enjoyed the story.
</nowiki></div>
